definitions.explanation: An appliance used to toast bread slices or heat small food items.

examples.japanese: トースターで{食|しょく}パンを{焼|や}く。
トースターが{壊|こわ}れたので{新|あたら}しいのを{買|か}った。
examples.english: The toaster broke, so I bought a new one.

examples.japanese: {餅|もち}はトースターで{焼|や}くと{美味|おい}しい。
examples.english: Mochi is delicious when toasted in a toaster.

notes:
トースター is a loanword from English 'toaster'.

TYPES IN JAPAN:
- ポップアップトースター (pop-up toaster)
- オーブントースター (toaster oven - most common in Japan)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- トースターで{焼|や}く (to toast in a toaster)
- トースターを{使|つか}う (to use a toaster)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, オーブントースター (toaster ovens) are more common than pop-up toasters. They're versatile enough to toast bread, heat {餅|もち}, bake small dishes, and reheat food. Many Japanese breakfast tables feature {食|しょく}パン ({食|しょく}{事|じ}パン, meal bread) toasted in a toaster oven.
